labels.what: All four voice tools (account_lookup, order_status, create_ticket, escalate) run against MockCrmAdapter with in-memory sample accounts and orders; escalate just returns accepted True. tool_executor._get_adapter always returns the mock
Adapter seam always returns the mock; comment says real CRM must be added
Hardcoded sample accounts (example.com emails, 555 phones) and three sample orders
create_ticket runs straight from the model call with no approval step (mock today)
create_ticket only checks that account_id exists; subject and body have no length or rate limit. Lookup by email alone with no caller verification
account_lookup returns any account by an email the caller says; voice prompt only asks the caller to confirm the email, no identity check
POST /realtime/session mints an OpenAI Realtime token for anyone; no auth and no rate limit, so anyone can spend the OpenAI account
POST /upload and the /files routes (list, download, delete per docs) have no auth
Browser posts the SDP offer straight to api.openai.com using a short-lived server-minted client secret (the supported pattern; no long-lived key in the browser)
Settings save waits 400 ms with setTimeout then shows a Settings saved toast; nothing is sent (comment says Demo-only)
API base falls back to http://localhost:8000
CORS origins default to localhost:3000 and 3001
Prompt tells the agent to confirm the caller's email and order number before acting and to escalate when frustrated; nothing in the tool code checks that confirmation happened
